name: nestprep-functions
description: NestPrep Cloud Functions — only what Firestore Security Rules cannot express (foundation ADR-0002).

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --project nestprep-643b7 --config ../firebase.json
scripts.test:rules: npm run rules:build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project nestprep-643b7 --config ../firebase.json "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:emulator
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project nestprep-643b7 --config ../firebase.json "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
